author: dmaretskyi
principle: Provide a type-safe builder API for composing layers/services, rather than requiring callers to hand-assemble them.
fix_shape: add a typed factory function (e.g. `layer({...})`) that returns the composed Layer.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Avoid issuing two round-trip queries when the common case can be satisfied by one.
fix_shape: restructure the query so the common path does a single statement (e.g. an upsert) instead of a check-then-write.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't widen a class's public/constructor API just to make it injectable for tests; that indicates the wrong seam.
fix_shape: find another way to test (e.g. a lower-level constructor or test-only factory) rather than adding a test-only optional constructor param.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Give parallel/analogous methods the same return type/shape so callers can treat them uniformly.
fix_shape: align the new method's return type with the existing analogous one.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Inject a shared dependency once through the constructor and store it as a field, rather than threading it as a parameter through every method.
fix_shape: accept the dependency in the constructor and reference the stored field in methods instead of passing it on each call.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Make a new secondary mechanism implement the same interface and reuse the same shared management code as existing instances of its kind, rather than growing a bespoke one-off implementation.
fix_shape: have the new component implement the shared interface and delegate to the common cursor-management code.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Expose a new drain/flush behavior as an option on the existing flush entrypoint, not a separate method, and cover it with a test.
fix_shape: add an options flag to the existing API and add tests exercising it.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't wrap Effect-based code in a plain class that mixes Promise-based glue; use the existing compositional Effect API so the code stays uniform with its surroundings.
fix_shape: delete the class and build the equivalent behavior using the Effect layer composition API.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't introduce a named constant for a literal used only to avoid retyping it, when it adds no clarity or type safety.
fix_shape: remove the constant and use the literal value directly at each use.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't perform expensive maintenance work implicitly inside a query/read path; make the caller explicitly trigger it through a dedicated API.
fix_shape: remove the implicit drain from the read path and add an explicit flush method the caller invokes when needed.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't expose test-only seams as constructor parameters; find a design that needs no injectable-for-tests escape hatch.
fix_shape: remove the optional constructor param and restructure so the component needs no test-only injection point.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When building a typed composition API, also expose a way for consumers to resolve the built result via a tag/service, not just a way to build it.
fix_shape: add a Context tag/service export alongside the builder function.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Keep an Effect-based module's public API entirely in Effect; don't mix Promise-returning methods into an Effect codebase.
fix_shape: convert the Promise-returning methods to Effect and update call sites.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Don't leave excessive/low-value explanatory comments in code meant to land; keep only comments that carry real information.
fix_shape: trim the comments down to what's necessary before merging.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Normalize a composite/encoded value into its own explicit columns rather than packing it into a single opaque field, and add a column to record provenance/source explicitly instead of inferring it.
fix_shape: split the packed field into separate typed columns and add an explicit source/provenance column.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Let the consumer derive its own keys/derived data from the raw payload instead of having the producer pre-compute and pass them separately.
fix_shape: pass the raw data and have the consumer extract what it needs, dropping the separately precomputed argument.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't add another ad hoc hash/utility implementation; consolidate on one shared implementation in a common utility package.
fix_shape: replace the local implementation with (or move it to) a single shared implementation in the common util package, and update other call sites to use it.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Model a new execution mode as just another step type the existing step-execution loop can run, rather than special-casing it as a separate branch or path.
fix_shape: add a new step kind to the existing step union and route it through the same executor loop.

author: wittjosiah
principle: A test that only checks a check exists and is wired up isn't enough; assert on the actual behavior the check is meant to catch.
fix_shape: add assertions that exercise the real behavior, not just presence/association.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Put logic in the module that already owns that responsibility rather than growing a parallel copy elsewhere, and pass configuration through the constructor rather than ad hoc options.
fix_shape: move the logic into the module that owns it and accept its config via constructor params.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Treat a new execution mode as another instance of the existing step abstraction, not a special-cased branch alongside it.
fix_shape: route the new mode through the same step-execution mechanism as every other step.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Thread configuration through explicit constructor params at the lower level, sourced from a proper config option higher up the stack, not an environment variable read inline.
fix_shape: replace the env-var lookup with a constructor parameter, resolved by the caller from the shared config.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't add a new method that duplicates an existing one's job; route through the existing one and remove the redundant addition.
fix_shape: delete the new method and call the existing equivalent instead.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Avoid keeping two parallel representations of the same concept; collapse them into one representation that captures the variation as data.
fix_shape: merge the two plan fields/types into a single plan representation.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't organize modules by syntactic kind (tags vs events); organize by subsystem/domain with real interface modules, so a real circular dependency isn't masked by type-only imports.
fix_shape: group tags/interfaces/events for each subsystem into one module per subsystem instead of one file per kind.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A low-level component driven by constructor params should not read environment variables itself; resolve environment-derived config at a higher layer and pass it down.
fix_shape: remove the env var read from the low-level module and pass the resolved value in via constructor params.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't add a new public method to express a variant when an existing constructor/param already declares it; keep one consistent API surface.
fix_shape: remove the extra public method and drive the behavior from the constructor param already recorded.
